title.zh: DOJ Seeks Forfeiture of $61M in Iranian Oil Proceeds Laundered Through Binance - cryptonews.net
title.en: DOJ Seeks Forfeiture of $61M in Iranian Oil Proceeds Laundered Through Binance - cryptonews.net

current_state.zh: The U.S. Department of Justice is seeking forfeiture of approximately $61 million in Iranian oil proceeds that were allegedly laundered through Binance, underscoring escalating sanctions enforcement against crypto platforms.
